resources.string: Waits a fixed %1$d s before every retry.
Waits a random %1$d–%2$d s before every retry. Each wait lands inside this range; it does not grow.
1 to 600 seconds. Equal values mean a fixed wait; otherwise every retry waits a random length inside the range.
0 to 100. 0 disables retries even when automatic retry is on. How long to wait is set below.
